912 followers of cult leader Jim Jones lay dead with their children following their "revolutionary suicide" in a British Guyana jungle compound. 1978

"Jonestown" was the informal name for the Peoples Temple Agricultural Project formed by an American religious organization under the leadership of Jim Jones. Most died from apparent cyanide poisoning, after being instructed to drink poisoned flavor-aid, in an event termed "revolutionary suicide" by Jones on an audio tape of the event. The deaths in Jonestown followed the murder of five others by Temple members including United States Congressman Leo Ryan. Jones died of gun shot wounds.

The actions in Jonestown have been commonly viewed as mass suicide, although some regard them as mass murder instead. It was the largest such event in modern history and resulted in the largest single loss of American civilian life in a deliberate act until September 11, 2001.

This is where the phrase "drinking the kool-aid" originated, although Kraft Foods is quick to note that Kool-Aid was not in fact used..
